custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interface between the beetle's tarsi (feet) and the sand grains. AI often struggles with occlusion here, causing legs to appear to float or merge with the ground. Also, verify that the white markings on the elytra follow the curvature of the body correctly and do not appear as flat stickers. Ensure the 'open_vocabulary_detector' successfully isolates each of the 6 legs before the 'topology_boundary_auditor' checks their edges.
image_description: A high-resolution, close-up photograph of a tiger beetle (Cicindelinae) positioned on a coarse, sandy substrate. The beetle features a metallic reddish-bronze and green exoskeleton with distinct pale cream-colored markings on its elytra. It possesses long, slender legs with reddish femora, prominent compound eyes, visible sickle-shaped mandibles, and long filiform antennae extending backward.
